naming: bg_{scene}_{flavor}_{theme}_v1.png — flavor omitted for base (e.g. bg_trail_light_v1)
layout: Mobile portrait 9:16, subtle atmospheric — calm center/lower area for UI and bottom nav

rules.base: Required light + dark per scene using master spec palettes
rules.flavors: Optional subtle regional tints — bamboo, sakura, snow, lantern — never overpower UI

scenes.desc: Default app atmosphere — distant sacred mountain, soft mist, minimal foreground
Journey trail — winding mountain path suggestion, fog, distant torii, very subtle
Camp hub — night/day camp mood, tent silhouette far background, warm glow hint
Shrine / achievements — torii and stone steps far background, sacred mist
Study / dojo — quiet learning atmosphere, scroll and forest hint

flavors.bamboo: Subtle bamboo stalk silhouettes at edges, moss green tint, very soft
flavors.sakura: Subtle sakura petals and soft pink atmospheric tint at edges only
flavors.snow: Subtle cool snow and pale blue mist at edges, winter quiet
flavors.lantern: Subtle warm lantern bokeh and amber glow at edges, night camp feeling
